#include <assert.h>

    HTMAlefHandle options_handle = htm_conversion_options_from_json("{\"convert_as_inline\":true}");
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<p>One</p><p>Two</p>", options_handle);
    htm_conversion_options_free(options_handle);
